purpose: Define the next horse-racing candidate architecture after diagnosing rank compression in the prior market recalibration layer, while minimizing degrees of freedom and preventing current-market leakage into the residual learner.

baseline.name: DIRECT_MARKET
baseline.definition: race-normalized inverse purchasable pre-race win odds at the preregistered snapshot

residual_model.residual_score_rule: produce horse-level residual score from strict-history/context features only; center residual scores within race before correction
residual_model.candidate_probability_rule: p_i proportional to p_market_i * exp(alpha_race * centered_residual_i), followed by race normalization

uncertainty_control.rule: alpha_race is bounded, nonnegative, and weakens as preregistered pre-race market uncertainty increases
uncertainty_control.reason_numeric_not_fixed: No executable trial is authorized yet; numeric choices must be frozen in a new externally anchored prereg before execution, not selected from validation/OOS.

required_invariants: alpha=0 implies candidate probabilities exactly equal direct market probabilities
constant residual across all horses implies candidate probabilities exactly equal direct market probabilities
all candidate probabilities are positive and sum to one per race
current market probability/odds are not residual-model features
feature set and order pass KEIBA-RESIDUAL-FEATURE-POLICY-V1 lint
newcomer races remain excluded from prediction and OrePro operation
primary_future_gate: mean paired race winner-logloss improvement versus DIRECT_MARKET > 0
paired race bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
improvement positive in every preregistered eval month
no systematic market-rank flattening beyond a preregistered diagnostic tolerance
blocked_until: Race-time Snapshot Gate v4 real Windows/JV-Link forward provenance PASS
new trial prereg externally anchored before execution
all source data hashes fixed before execution
forbidden: reuse final/closing odds as prediction-time current market
add held-out features after seeing trial outcomes
